title: Immunotherapy with a JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor (baricitinib) and an mTORC1 inhibitor (sirolimus), alone and in combination, for the control of HIV-1 replication after antiretroviral treatment interruption: a phase II multicenter, multi-arm, multi-stage, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, adaptative trial
official: Immunotherapy with a JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor (baricitinib) and an mTORC1 inhibitor (sirolimus), alone and in combination, for the control of HIV-1 replication after antiretroviral treatment interruption: a phase II multicenter, multi-arm, multi-stage, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, adaptative trial
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the safety and efficacy of the three experimental immunotherapeutic interventions (baricitinib alone, sirolimus alone, or their combination) in remaining ART-free after ATI.
